title: Per-token allocations journey and pricing slate
creator: Ava Mendez
description: Design and prototype a lightweight, composable set of UI patterns for token-level cost allocation, attribution, and export flows in the Redwood Console. Focus on: 1) a compact per-token allocation card for list & detail pages, 2) a guided export flow (CSV/Parquet) that preserves allocation provenance, and 3) a pricing-slate interaction for previewing alternate ratecards and immediate cost delta feedback. Deliverables: Figma prototype, interaction spec, and handoff tokens for frontend. Coordinate with Product and Instrumentation to ensure necessary telemetry and CSV schema alignment.
acceptance_criteria: Per-token allocation card component in Figma with responsive states (list, expanded detail)
Export flow prototype that includes field mapping, time-window selection, and provenance metadata checkbox
Pricing slate micro-interaction shows cost delta for selected ratecards with inline explanations
Console engineering acceptance review completed and front-end ticket created
CSV/Parquet sample files documented in Confluence and validated against analytics ETL schema
